profile_md: Penn's verified provision is distributed rather than institution-wide. The clearest route meeting all three criteria with current delivery is **Wharton Impact & Sustainability Consulting (WISC)**: selective, co-curricular teams of about five undergraduate/graduate students consult for external clients over 12 weeks, with weekly client meetings and a final client presentation (Fall 2026 clients listed; open to any Penn/Wharton student). Programme-embedded client consulting also exists in Wharton (EMBA Social Impact Consulting Practicum, 2025 article; MBA Field Application Projects, e.g. HCMG 6530 teams of 5-6 consulting for a health firm) but their current delivery is not dated. Penn Engineering Senior Design is a compulsory-style team capstone, yet external sponsorship is only 'many projects ... in collaboration with industry partners' with one named startup (C unclear). The Fels MPA capstone has government and nonprofit clients but appears individual. The Netter Center's ABCS network (33 courses in Spring 2026) is university-wide and partner-based, but mostly teaching/service with school and community hosts, so project/group/client status needs course-level testing. Nothing qualifying was found in natural sciences, law or design beyond leads. Uncertain: Weitzman studios, Nursing/health teams, student consulting clubs, departmental engineering sponsors.
gaps: Reduced-depth (~15 searches). Not verified: Weitzman studio course-level client briefs; Penn Carey Law clinics; Nursing/health team courses; Wharton FAP/EMBA practicum current delivery and credit; engineering departmental sponsor schemes (CIS 4010 etc.); individual ABCS courses with partner-set group projects; Wharton student clubs. Further departmental instances likely. WebFetch summaries are tool-generated, not verbatim.
